cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: WHY v4 READ BLAND: every sentence resolved itself. A run of true, verified, well-ordered facts with no tension carried between them, so there was never a reason to stay for the next line. Loops open at any moment: v4 had ONE. The reference has TWO TO THREE, always. v5 rebuilds with seven overlapping loops and moves the UMS ahead of the product reveal, so the product arrives as the answer to a standard she has already agreed to. Product now appears at ~75%, later than the reference's 68%.

cards.title: OURS v5 — seven loops, UMS before reveal  ·  script-v5.md, ~455 words, ~2:45

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: The diagnosis
cards.text: v4 read bland because every sentence resolved itself. True, verified, well-ordered facts with no tension carried between them. Nothing withheld means no reason to stay for the next line. Citations buy credibility, which is not retention. Loops open at any moment: v4 had ONE, the reference has TWO TO THREE.

cards.title: The three rules the reference follows
cards.text: 1. Always two or three loops open at once. L1 runs 80 seconds underneath everything while short 7-9 second loops fire on top. 2. The explicit gate contains ZERO information — 'this is where the research becomes the whole point' says nothing, it only promises. 3. The gate is VISUAL as well as verbal: at 1:00 the ad leaves the anatomy, cuts to her at a research screen, then dives back for the payoff.

cards.title: Structural deviation, deliberate
cards.text: The reference reveals the product at 1:31 and THEN teaches its solution mechanism. v5 inverts it per Brooks: UMS taught unbranded as a three-part checklist, product arrives afterward as the thing that meets a standard she already agreed to. Matches house structural law (canonical section 5). This is the one place v5 knowingly breaks mirror fidelity.

cards.title: The checklist slots are the visual loop
cards.text: Three empty numbered boxes appear when the UMS starts and stay on screen unfilled through the competitor shelf. She is looking at an unanswered question for roughly forty seconds. That is the retention device the reference gets from its research-screen gate, adapted.

cards.title: PRODUCT-TRUTH CALL — unchanged from v4, still the real decision
cards.text: Celery has no citable prokinetic support and the literature leans the OTHER way (apigenin decreases peristaltic performance in guinea-pig models). Our chlorophyll dose is 540mcg against 60-200mg in every study, so 100 to 300 times below anything tested. Every citation in the script sits on the problem side. The only solution-side number used is the FOS dose, which our label genuinely earns.

cards.title: Open
cards.text: 1. The product-truth call. 2. Runtime 2:45 vs the reference's 2:13, the overage is entirely the checklist — trim to two criteria if you want it closer, but that costs the 'almost nothing does all three' beat. 3. Skeleton look-dev: 3 variants of beat 1.
